etymologies.etymologyHTML: From refine +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: The act, or the result of refining; the removal of impurities, or a purified material

quote.citation: 1974 February 2, Nancy Walker, “Call of the Wild”, in Gay Community News, volume 1, number 32, page 11:
quote.text: There was no bathroom in the cabin. Such refinements don't exist in the woods, apparently.
